data.name: Auto Ranging
data.teaser: Your scope zeroes itself to whatever you're aiming at. Aim, and the sight snaps to the closest zeroing distance — no clicking through steps mid-fight. Now also zeroes for the ammo actually in your gun, not the weapon's default round.
data.description:
Description

Your scope zeroes itself to whatever you’re aiming at, and now accounts for the ammo you actually loaded.

Ranging

  • Auto — while ADS, the mod checks the distance ahead every 0.3s and keeps the zero matched to your target
  • Manual — flip Auto Range off and range on demand with Alt+R (rebindable)

Ammo aware zeroing

Tarkov calibrates your scope against the weapon’s default ammo no matter what you loaded. An AK-74 is always zeroed for PS gs at 890 m/s — load 5.45 US gs at 303 m/s and your rounds land well under the reticle, visibly so from about 100 m.

  • Zeroing is recalculated from the cartridge actually chambered, using the game’s own trajectory solver
  • Re-solves when you switch ammo mid-raid
  • Does nothing when the loaded round is already the weapon’s default
  • Toggleable, on by default
Install Instructions
  1. Extract the archive
  2. Drop the BepInEx folder into your SPT root directory
  3. Optionally set your preferences in the F12 menu

Requires SPT 4.1.x. Upgrading from 1.0.0 is a straight overwrite. Still on SPT 4.0? Stay on v1.0.0.

Known Limitations / Bugs

None currently known. If you find one, please report it (see Support tab).

Support

Found a bug or have a question? Leave a comment on this mod’s page, or reach out in my thread on the SPT Discord: https://discord.com/channels/875684761291599922/1521972310595338260

versions.description:
**Requires SPT 4.1.x.** This build will not load on 4.0.x — stay on [v1.0.0](https://github.com/Vultify/AutoRanging/releases/tag/v1.0.0) if you are still on 4.0.x

### Added
**Ammo aware zeroing.** Tarkov calibrates a scope's zeroing against the weapon's *default* ammo no matter what you actually loaded — an AK-74 is always zeroed for PS gs at 890 m/s. Load 5.45 US gs at 303 m/s and your rounds land well under the reticle, visibly so from about 100 m out.

Zeroing is now recalculated from the cartridge actually chambered, using the game's own trajectory solver, so drop matches the velocity of what you are firing. It re-solves when you switch ammo mid-raid, and does nothing at all when the loaded round is already the weapon's default.

Toggleable in F12 under `2. Ranging` → `Ammo Aware Zeroing`, on by default.

### Changed
- Rebuilt against the deobfuscated SPT 4.1 client assemblies

### Install
Extract into your SPT root folder. Lands as `BepInEx/plugins/AutoRanging/AutoRanging.dll`.
Initial release — Auto-ranging scope mod that automatically adjusts zeroing based on distance while ADS. Includes auto and manual ranging modes with F12 configuration.
